sentences.text:
Respondent
 Through: Mr. Hitesh Vali, App with Si
 Pradeep, PS-Prem Nagar.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravinder Dudeja
 Order
% 06.08.2025 CRL.M.A. 22843/2025 (exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. This is a petition under Section 528 BNSS, 2023 read with Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No. 0088/2024 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, registered at Police Station Prem Nagar, as also the consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

2. It is submitted that parties have come to an amicable settlement and in terms of the settlement,
petitioner No. 1 is to pay Rs. 3,00,000/- to the respondent No. 2.

He further states that Rs.
1,50,000/- has already been paid to respondent No. 2 while the balance amount of Rs. 1,50,000/-
shall be paid
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/08/2025 at 22:45:28 at the time of first/second motion.
3. The present petition would be taken up after completion of second motion.

4. Re-notify on 15.01.2026.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J AUGUST 6, 2025/vd
